note: Fillmore County zones its unincorporated land (zoning regulations and an Official Zoning Map), and Geneva, Fairmont and other villages zone their own, but the county and town zoning maps are published only as PDFs or web map images. ArcGIS Hub and Online searches for Fillmore, Geneva and Fairmont zoning returned no queryable zoning district layer; the only GIS found is a parcel/assessor viewer (Beacon) that does not expose zoning.
